title: inhale the Mist
direction: Begin with fine scattered impacts, then let the rain organize into irregular clusters around the structural change near 2:16. Keep drops small and numerous; use only a few stronger accents. It should feel like pressure gathering in mist, not percussion visualization.

sections.name: streams: opening
sections.note: Independent fine streams; complexity comes from superposition. Measured note patterns carry the main surface; incidental weather is held behind them.
